column3: 誰かが文句を言う、都市長あたりがいいかな、分からず屋ぽく
column4: Someone complains, maybe the city mayor, acting stubborn and ignorant.

column4: Rejecting new things just because one attempt failed is too rigid thinking.

column3: わかるように説明しろ

column4: This machine called a computer, in itself, is a special thing.

column3: 未知のテクノロジーで作られておりさっぱりわかんが
column4: It is made with unknown technology, so I don't understand it at all,

column4: But when exchanging information, it opens otherworldly gates

column3: この娘の話では、このコンピューター自体は正常だそうだから
column4: According to this girl, the computer itself is functioning normally.

column3: この異界ゲートを通った先にある異界で何か事故が起こっているのだろう
column4: There must have been some kind of accident in the otherworld beyond this otherworld gate.

column3: ・・・わからん、で、どうすればいい
column4: ...I don't understand. So, what should we do?

column3: 直接、その異界にいって確かめてみるしかなかろう。
